camera_semantics: camera_id is never null and never empty: unknown_metadata (no metadata_json), no_camera (metadata present, no RAW burst key), a protocol camera name (single camera) or multi_camera, with the exact set in camera_ids; sensor_metadata_present is the independent metadata flag, so 'no sensor metadata' never collapses into 'single camera'
group_rule: rawvla_sequence.source_group on the raw-cache-root-relative path; the dataset namespace is this file's dataset_format plus split_version
notes: four regions are drawn from the same demonstration pool; the RawVLA author cache ships no official train/test partition for these RAW files
paired RGB caches mirror the RAW relative paths 1:1 and are excluded here so one trajectory is counted once
rows keep relative paths; loader_split_manifest resolves them to absolute server paths
this manifest is consumed by RawVLASequenceDataset(split_manifest=...)
relative_path_base: server raw cache root passed as raw_cache_root=...
time_order_note: manifest rows and every NPZ frame array they point at are oldest_first; the loader emits [T, C, H, W] oldest-first and only a named time_order_adapter may convert to the newest-first DBSR fusion entry
